strongest_outside_mask_countermatch.observed: C24 has a conspicuous rounded cloud front descending beside the central cupola-bearing roof into the road corridor; early300 leaves that nearer corridor comparatively clear while much cloud remains higher/farther behind the roofs.
strongest_outside_mask_countermatch.location: Qualitative native C region roughly x560–735,y340–535, below the dynamic rectangle's y335 limit, left of fit x790, and right of static-evaluation x440. These are approximate visual locators, not new measured annotations.
strongest_outside_mask_countermatch.consequence: A favorable upper cloud-region score does not establish whole-picture or shared-exposure identity. The same type of contrary lower-cloud detail appears for C19 against240/270.
strongest_outside_mask_countermatch.not_claimed: Not exclusion of all shared footage, proof of a different camera, deliberate manipulation, causal mechanism, or a calibrated timing difference.

sequence_assessment.reason: No unique changing-detail correspondences at all three moments under one defensible geometry. The dynamic leaders are not even monotonically ordered across C14,C19,C24: baseline540,270,1049; alternative570,240,300. This descriptive ordering is not itself an exclusion test, but it cannot support an ordered exposure mapping. Static-fit600 recurs across moments without providing temporal identity.
alternatives: Neighboring exposures in the same or related passage can share scenery and broad cloud shapes.
A nearby camera can share the same skyline and broadly evolving cloud.
Derivative crop, unequal pixel aspect, tone, compression, resolution and unsupported geometry can produce disagreement without historical manipulation.
